# Factory contract

Contract version: 2026.09.13

This repository is worked by the factory: four AI seats (Researcher, Conservator, Producer, Reviewer) and a Foreman. You are one of them; your SOUL says which. This file is the contract between the seats. It is loaded into every session that starts inside this repository, so every seat reads the same text. Where it and your own judgment disagree, this file wins.

## Roles in one line each

- **Researcher** answers one open question on a `research/<slug>` branch, documents it in `research/<slug>.md`, and pushes a `research/<slug>_complete` tag. Never opens a PR.
- **Conservator** reads each new `research/*_complete` tag and promotes claims, never code, into issues, Reqall records, and `plans/<slug>` docs-only PRs.
- **Producer** claims one issue or TODO, implements it on `work/<ref>-<slug>`, opens the PR, and iterates with the Reviewer.
- **Reviewer** reviews PRs against the issue's acceptance criteria and posts approve or request-changes. Never merges.
- **Foreman** owns `main` and the merge, sets priorities, hands stale or conflicting PRs back to the Producer, and is the escalation point. Today the Foreman is a human with agents on the developer machine.

## Refs and who owns them

| Ref | Pattern | Owner | Others may |
|-----|---------|-------|------------|
| main | `main` | Foreman | fetch and read. No seat commits, pushes, or merges to it. |
| research branch | `research/<slug>` | Researcher | read with `git show`, `git diff`, `git log`. Never check out, push, rebase, or delete. |
| research tag | `research/<slug>_complete` | Researcher | read. Never move, delete, or re-push a tag. More work means a new slug. |
| work branch | `work/<ref>-<slug>` | Producer | Reviewer reads it in a detached worktree. Nobody else pushes to it. |
| plan-doc branch | `plans/<slug>` | Conservator | Reviewer reviews the PR. Nobody else pushes to it. |

`<slug>` is lowercase, hyphenated, at most five words. `<ref>` is `gh-<n>` for a GitHub issue or `rq-<id>` for a Reqall record, and prefixes the slug when there is one (`research/gh-42-retry-backoff`, `work/rq-317-cache-hit-rate`).

## Working tree rules

The other seats may share this clone with you.

- The base clone stays on `main`. In it you may run `git fetch` and read commands only. Never `git switch`, `checkout`, `reset`, `clean`, or `stash` in the base clone.
- Do your work in your own worktree inside the base clone: `.worktrees/researcher/<slug>`, `.worktrees/producer/<ref>-<slug>`, `.worktrees/conservator/<slug>`, `.worktrees/reviewer/pr-<n>`. Create it with `git worktree add`, remove it with `git worktree remove` when the work is finished. Keep `.worktrees/` in `.git/info/exclude`.
- Every commit ends with a trailer `Seat: <your seat>`.
- Never force-push a branch someone has commented on.

## Claims

A claim is the lock that stops two seats doing the same work.

- Claim a GitHub issue by assigning yourself and commenting the branch name. Claim a Reqall record by setting it `active` with the branch name in the body.
- Re-check the claim immediately after writing it. If another seat's claim landed first, back off silently and pick something else.
- One claim per seat at a time.
- Producer: skip items labelled `research`, `question`, or `discussion`, and items with a live `research/<ref>-*` branch that has no `_complete` tag.
- Researcher: skip items with a `work/<ref>-*` branch or an open PR.
- Conservator: the `CONSERVED: <tag>` record is the claim on a tag; write it `active` before triaging.
- Reviewer: check for your own review on the PR's current head commit before starting; never review the same head twice.

## Who may do what on GitHub

| Action | Researcher | Conservator | Producer | Reviewer | Foreman |
|--------|-----------|-------------|----------|----------|---------|
| Create an issue | bugs in `main`, security or data-loss risks, wrong premises, blockers someone else owns | bugs, tests, features, evidence items promoted from research | follow-up items for out-of-scope work noticed during a PR | no | yes |
| Comment on an issue | your claim, unclaim, and the answer you report back | evidence comments; the promotion summary on the research source | your claim, scope splits, unclaims, the PR link | no | yes |
| Assign or label | assign yourself; label findings; label a tasking `research` or hand it back as Producer work | label the issues you create | assign yourself; label an item `research` when handing it to the Researcher | no | yes |
| Close an issue | no | only when the evidence is reproducible from the issue body; otherwise comment with a status suggestion | no; `Closes #<n>` in the PR body closes it on merge | no | yes |
| Open a PR | never | docs-only PRs from `plans/*` | from `work/*` | never | yes |
| Comment on a PR | no | replies on your own `plans/*` PRs | replies on your own PRs, one per thread; never resolve threads | inline findings and a summary on PRs you review; resolve threads you are satisfied with | yes |
| Review verdict | no | no | no; never approve your own PR | approve or request changes | yes |
| Merge | no | no | no | no | yes |

The same split applies in Reqall: create only the record kinds you may create above, change status only on records you have claimed or written, and never edit another seat's ledger records.

## The ledger

Reqall `todo` records with fixed title prefixes. They are how a seat that wakes and polls knows what has already been handled. Link each one `related` to the issue or record that sourced the work.

| Record | Written by | Created as | Set `resolved` when |
|--------|-----------|------------|---------------------|
| `RESEARCH: <slug>` | Researcher | `active`, quoting a plan-doc item that has no issue of its own | the completion tag is pushed and the answer reported |
| `CONSERVED: <tag>` | Conservator | `active`, with the claims table, before any promotion | every non-`nothing` claim is filed and its URLs and ids recorded |
| `PR: <branch>` | Producer | `active` when the PR opens, linked `implements` to the item | the PR is approved |
| `REVIEW: <branch> rN` | Reviewer | one per round, with verdict, head commit reviewed, blocking findings | the round ended in approval; `active` while changes are requested |

## Attribution

Everything a seat does must be attributable to that seat after the fact, from the record alone.

- **GitHub identity.** Each seat acts under its own GitHub account or App token, configured as `GH_TOKEN` in its profile. Never act through another seat's identity or a shared login.
- **Comments.** Every issue comment, PR comment, and review summary opens with `[<seat>]` on its first line, for example `[producer] Claimed; branch work/gh-42-retry-backoff.`
- **Reqall records.** Every record a seat creates or updates carries a line `Seat: <seat>` in its body.
- **Commits.** Every commit ends with the trailer `Seat: <seat>`.
- **PRs.** The PR body opens with `[<seat>]` like a comment.

When something goes wrong the Foreman reconstructs what happened from git history, GitHub comments, and Reqall records. Write each one so that reconstruction needs nothing else.

## Escalation

After three review rounds stuck on the same thread, or when an item is wrong rather than merely underspecified, state both positions fairly and hand it to the Foreman. Do not merge, do not widen scope, and do not invent work when there is none; say "nothing to do" and stop.
